description.en: Slender branching stems carry whorls of wedge-shaped leaves and climbing adaptations.
description.zh: 细分枝茎带轮生楔形叶及攀援适应结构。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Sphenophyllum; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Sphenophyllum 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Broad wedge whorls and climbing stem topology differ from needle-whorled horsetails.
distinctness.zh: 宽楔形叶轮及攀援茎拓扑区别于细针轮生木贼。

modeling_brief.en: Use an open trailing framework with fan wedges; include a few referenced hooked tips without a separate support-tree asset.
modeling_brief.zh: 用疏开的拖曳枝架和扇楔叶建形，加入少量有据钩尖，不另计支撑树。

assets.uncertainty: Growth form varies among species; do not impose this climbing habit on every Sphenophyllum.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Turn back time: plant fossils find a way
sources.supports: Sphenophyllum climbing hooks; Medullosa large fronds on relatively small stems.

description.en: A fern trunk is surrounded by a thick mantle of adventitious roots beneath the crown.
description.zh: 蕨类干体在叶冠下方被厚不定根套包围。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Psaronius; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Psaronius 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Root-mantled trunk geometry makes this a tree fern rather than an enlarged ground fern rosette.
distinctness.zh: 根套包干的几何结构使其成为树蕨，而非放大的地面蕨莲座。

modeling_brief.en: Build a flared root mantle with bundled surface ridges and a central crown; choose fronds from a compatible reconstruction.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立带束状表面脊的外扩根套和中央叶冠，叶片选自相容重建。

assets.uncertainty: Frond associations and crown layout need species-level selection; no separate root-slab asset.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Stammscheibe eines Baumfarns
sources.supports: Psaronius stem and surrounding adventitious-root mantle.

description.en: A broad fan-like fern lamina has fused sectors and a netted vein pattern.
description.zh: 宽扇状蕨叶具有愈合叶区及网状叶脉。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Hausmannia, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Hausmannia 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Continuous fan lamina contrasts with the separated pinnules of the existing fern cluster.
distinctness.zh: 连续扇状叶面区别于现有蕨丛的分离小羽片。

modeling_brief.en: Keep the fan as a folded lowpoly sheet with a few major vein ridges; do not count individual lobes as assets.
modeling_brief.zh: 以折面低多边形薄片构成叶扇，保留少数主脉脊；不把各裂片另计。

assets.uncertainty: Morphogenus and fossil frond only; full habit is unknown and margin varies among species.
assets.reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: Hausmannia from the Lower Cretaceous of Vancouver Island
sources.supports: Fan-shaped reticulate fern foliage and attached reproductive structures.

description.en: A divided fern frond radiates lobed segments from a basal forked system.
description.zh: 分裂蕨叶的裂片从基部分叉系统放射开展。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Dictyophyllum, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Dictyophyllum 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Palmate branching with lobed long segments differs from Hausmannia's continuous fan and a pinnate rosette fern.
distinctness.zh: 掌状分枝及长裂叶段区别于Hausmannia连续叶扇和羽状莲座蕨。

modeling_brief.en: Make the basal divergence legible and separate the lobed rays with negative space; retain a specimen-like planar layout.
modeling_brief.zh: 清楚呈现基部发散，以留空分开有裂片的长叶射线，保留标本式平面布局。

assets.uncertainty: Dictyophyllum may be an unnatural morphogenus; choose one named specimen before production.
